panelSub: Your own voice room. It disappears when everyone has left.
ownerHere: {user} is still here and runs this room.
beInside: Join the room first to claim it.
ownerOnly: Only {user} (or the staff) can change this room.
renameWait: Discord allows 2 renames per 10 minutes. Try again {when}.
failed: That didn't work. ARCHON may be missing a permission here.
needManage: ARCHON needs the Manage Channels permission to create the rooms.
readyBody: Join {hub}: ARCHON creates your own room and moves you in. Rename it, set a limit or lock it from the panel in its chat.
missing: ARCHON is missing: {perms}. Give it these permissions on the category, or the rooms won't work.
offDone: The "join to create" channel is removed. Rooms in use close when they empty.
offNone: Voice rooms weren't on in this server.
serverOnly: This only works in a server.
adminOnly: You need the Manage Server permission.
